name: FAME Challenge 2026
description: The advancements of technology have led to the use of multimodal systems in various real-world applications. Among them, audio-visual systems are among the most widely used multimodal systems. In the recent years, associating face and voice of a person has gained attention due to the presence of unique correlation between them. The Face-voice Association in Multilingual Environments (FAME) 2026 Challenge focuses on exploring face-voice association under the unique condition of a multilingual scenario. This condition is inspired from the fact that half of the world's population is bilingual and most often people communicate under multilingual scenarios. The challenge uses a dataset named Multilingual Audio-Visual (MAV-Celeb) for exploring face-voice association in multilingual environments. This report provides the details of the challenge, dataset, baseline models, and task details for the FAME Challenge.
reputation: A challenge benchmark in the face-voice association community that is emerging as a shared evaluation setting, but it is still relatively new and specialized.
notes: Multimodal challenge benchmark; performance can vary substantially with dataset splits, multilingual conditions, and whether models use face, voice, or both modalities.
